title: Haou Taikei Ryuu Knight - Lord of Paladin
aliases: Haou Taikei Ryuu Knight: Lord of Paladin
description: An action RPG that depicts the story of Adeu: a young boy training to be a paladin. He goes out on a quest to recover a legendary and mysterious weapon, the Earth's Blade, which has been shattered into 12 pieces.
